result.headline: No clear control-loop failure; start-up warnings and dead airspeed/yaw-rate channels point to sensor or power health.
result.explanation: Roll follows its setpoint with about 1 s lag (corr 0.989), so the control loop works. Low-voltage and sensor-health warnings fire together at t=0.209 s, and airspeed and yaw rate are constant zero.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.209 s controller.event[mavros: System] mavros: System: ERROR: Sensor helth
evidence.shows: Sensor health error at the very start, simultaneous with the battery warning

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.209 s controller.event[mavros: Battery] mavros: Battery: WARN: Low voltage
evidence.shows: Low-voltage warning at the same instant as the sensor error

evidence.quote: CONSTANT vehicle.airspeed = 0 for the whole recording (1629 samples)
evidence.shows: Airspeed never moves during flight, so that sensor or its stream is dead

evidence.quote: CONSTANT vehicle.yaw_rate[yaw] = 0 for the whole recording (553 samples)
evidence.shows: Yaw rate is also frozen at zero

evidence.quote: TRACKING vehicle.attitude[roll] diverged from its setpoint from t=0 to 0.973 s (peak |error| 46.097 deg)
evidence.shows: Largest tracking error is the start-up transient; the setpoint jumped -44.94 to 44.67 within 0.45 s

checked.result: corr -0.145 and 0.19, so neither channel is a simple servo for that axis

checked.result: none left baseline; only the two simultaneous events at 0.209 s

effects.why: Descent of about 20 m during the setpoint swing; follows the manoeuvre
